method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill (and references/regulative.md), from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18 and the rulings on negatives of 2026-11-04 and 2026-11-05 (JUST FALSE where the text says no, NOTHING with a NOTHING-kind tag where it does not answer); dates in a small module (built-in date functions, no daydate), the rules in one module and the person aggrieved's questions in a seat module importing it; three regulative rules (the s 63 complaint time limit with the Commissioner's s 63(2) power, the ss 65/71 review application, the s 100(2) appeal) run by EVALTRACE inside exported questions that take only plain facts; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Anti-Discrimination Act 1998 (Tas), No. 46 of 1998, consolidated version published 2025-07-01 and current at point in time 2026-11-06, as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/act-1998-046.txt (text sha256 07fbec41559589514afd5073c89b7ed8d306898710a0ebe616693b6c8516cb21 per the .meta.json), retrieved from legislation.tas.gov.au on 2026-11-06

seat: the person aggrieved: the individual against whom discrimination or prohibited conduct was directed, who may complain to the Anti-Discrimination Commissioner (a worker or job applicant, student, tenant, customer, club member, person seeking insurance or superannuation, person dealing with a State agency) (tad-seat.l4); exceptions the respondent must prove (s 101) are asked from the same seat

checks.l4: stable l4 of VS Code extension legalese.l4-vscode 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset
checks.command: l4 run tad-dates.l4 ; l4 run tad-rules.l4 ; l4 run tad-seat.l4 ; l4 run tad-cases.l4
checks.result: 161 assertions written, 161 satisfied, 0 errors, 0 warnings in every file (2026-11-07)
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics were read and counted. Expected values worked by hand from the text.

scope: Focus: the provisions a claimant meets. In: ss 3 (as used), 14-22; Part 5 Divisions 1-10 (ss 23-54) and s 55; Division 11 as a granted exemption, with the s 59 review period; Part 6 as it meets the complainant: ss 60, 60A, 62(1), 63, 64(1), (2), 65(3), (4), 66(1), 68(6), (7), 71(4), (5), 72, 73, 76(4), 78(2), 78(4), 80(4), 89(1), (2), 90, 91(1), 92(1), 93, 94(4), 99(3), 100(2), 101; Part 7: ss 102, 104, 108(1). Out: Parts 2 and 3, ss 56-58, the Commissioner's and Tribunal's procedure, the offences, the TCAT Act costs provisions, s 100(4), Schedules 1 and 2, s 108(2), machinery. Reasons in NOTES.md.
